description: This file defines a helper class 'Env' for accessing environment variables, specifically providing a getter for API base URL and a validation method to ensure required variables are set.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class to access environment variables, providing methods to retrieve the API base URL and validate environment setup.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: A getter that returns the API base URL from environment variables, defaulting to 'http://localhost:8080/api' if not set.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether the 'API_BASE_URL' environment variable is set, throwing an assertion error if it is not.
